title: Task header (machine part of a worker packet)

packet.description: Path (repo-relative) to the prose worker packet (.md).

implementers.description: Preference order. Runner picks the first host whose capabilities satisfy `requires`.

requires.description: doctor.ps1 levels the implementer host must PASS, e.g. UNITY_MCP_SMOKE_PASS.

writeSet.description: Repo-relative globs (** and *). Changes outside => BLOCKED(scope).

baselineRef.description: Commit/tag from BEFORE the work under test (e.g. the previous WP closure tag). Required for any 'pre-existing failure' claim; the runner base commit already contains the work.

context.description: minimal = implementer chi doc packet + file packet neu ten (task xac minh). Mac dinh full (chuoi doc bat buoc cua AGENTS.md).

profile.description: Profile mac dinh cua task trong config/run-profiles.json (ghi de bang -Profile).
